description:
Port-map §1 + §2. Owns the terminal surface.

- OctoPi.Tui.Terminal GenServer.
- init: RawMode.enter/0 → enable paste + focus + hidden cursor →
  :os.set_signal(:sigwinch, :handle) → spawn_link a reader loop
  that calls :io.get_chars("", 256) and sends {:stdin_chunk, bin}
  back to the GenServer.
- handle_info({:signal, :sigwinch}, _): broadcast {:resize, rows,
  cols} via OctoPi.Tui.Events; update cached dims.
- handle_info({:stdin_chunk, bin}, _): forward to StdinFSM (.3)
  once that exists; for now, broadcast {:stdin_chunk, bin} via
  Events so .3 can pick it up later without a direct dep.
- terminate/2: restore cursor + paste + focus + RawMode.exit/0.
- Telemetry: [:octo_pi_tui, :terminal, :start | :stop | :resize].

TDD:
- start_link + terminate cleanly flips raw on + off (use a mock
  RawMode module injectable via config so tests don't actually
  flip the test-runner's tty).
- SIGWINCH delivery → {:resize, _, _} observed on Events.
- stdin reader forwards chunks (mock :io.get_chars/2 or inject a
  reader fn).
- :io.columns/0 fallback to 80 when :enotsup.

Depends on .1.
title: Terminal GenServer: raw mode + SIGWINCH + lazy stdin reader
